name: Therapy Session
query:
SELECT 
    start_date AS "Date",
    patient AS "Child Name",
    therapy_type AS "Therapy",
    doctor_name AS "Therapist",
    CONCAT(
    TIME_FORMAT(from_time, '%%H:%%i'),
        ' - ',
        TIME_FORMAT(to_time, '%%H:%%i')
    ) AS "Time",
    status AS "Status"
FROM 
    `tabTherapy Session`
